questions.title: What types of content can I save?
questions.content: Purl supports links (any URL), PDFs, YouTube videos, and audio files. When you save a link, Purl automatically fetches its title, favicon, description, and thumbnail. Uploading PDF and audio files requires Pro.

questions.title: Is there a free trial?
questions.content: Yes. Every new account starts with a 7-day Pro trial — no credit card required. You get unlimited saves and file uploads. After the trial your account moves to the Free plan unless you upgrade.

questions.title: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
questions.content: Free lets you save up to 100 links and search them. Pro ($39 one-time) unlocks unlimited saves and PDF & audio uploads. New accounts start with a 7-day free Pro trial.

questions.title: Is my saved content private?
questions.content: Yes. Your library is private to you — only you can see what you've saved. Purl does not share your content with other users or use it to train AI models.
